{"artifact":"SmeDossierEnvelope","schema_version":"0.4.0","stage_id":"02.dossier_sections","probe":"rdmv-mi-s","lineage":{"input_manifest_sha256":"e9460549c60d60796fb71f957ebfee665ed649459a297121986efcf6c68d3677","candidate_lineage_id":"2026-10-28-rdmv-mi-class-std:lineage:55","source_registry_sha256":"7af7437894a2c63b20529c8a1ed7c10696796036051dd6666178ab579008ca37","source_liveness_sha256":"e81e5179580dc89fb25fdf5194e9f75291db3aa019fc21ccfe32c38d1a9df42f"},"envelope_scope":{"kind":"partial_chunk","assigned_section_ids":["C2"],"chunk_index":1,"chunk_total":1},"section_char_limit":12000,"sections":[{"section_id":"C2","chunk_id":"C2.01","merge_seq":1,"domain":"Safe driving, intersections and freeways","heading":"C2 — Oncoming vehicles, bad weather, skids and braking, confusables and KG hints","learner_facing":false,"markdown":"## C2 — Oncoming vehicles, bad weather, skids and braking, confusables and KG hints

FACT_ID: sec13-R01 | anchor: A04
If an oncoming vehicle is in your lane, tap the horn if there is time, brake hard without locking the wheels if you lack anti-lock brakes, and look for an escape route on the right edge. [A04]
Why it matters: group emergencies; difficulty high; prereq none; confusables sec13-R02 [A04]
Source: [A04 -> src:rdmv-mi-s:michigan-department-of-state-secretary-o:handbook:pdf-0076]

FACT_ID: sec13-R02 | anchor: A04
Avoid swerving left from an oncoming vehicle, because its driver may notice you and return to the proper lane; stop in your lane only if there is room and you cannot pull off. [A04]
Why it matters: group emergencies; difficulty high; prereq none; confusables sec13-R01 [A04]
Source: [A04 -> src:rdmv-mi-s:michigan-department-of-state-secretary-o:handbook:pdf-0076]

FACT_ID: sec13-R03 | anchor: A04
If you cannot stop before hitting another vehicle, steer around it, turning no more than you need. [A04]
Why it matters: group emergencies; difficulty medium; prereq none; confusables none [A04]
Source: [A04 -> src:rdmv-mi-s:michigan-department-of-state-secretary-o:handbook:pdf-0076]

FACT_ID: sec13-R04 | anchor: A04
Pre-winter maintenance is the best way to travel safely: check power steering, brake, washer and oil fluids, keep antifreeze strong and fresh, and consider washer fluid with antifreeze. [A04]
Why it matters: group bad weather; difficulty low; prereq none; confusables none [A04]
Source: [A04 -> src:rdmv-mi-s:michigan-department-of-state-secretary-o:handbook:pdf-0076]

FACT_ID: sec13-R05 | anchor: A04
In fog, rain or snow leave extra time, drive slower and increase following distance, and remember bridges and underpasses freeze before the road in cold weather. [A04]
Why it matters: group bad weather; difficulty medium; prereq none; confusables none [A04]
Source: [A04 -> src:rdmv-mi-s:michigan-department-of-state-secretary-o:handbook:pdf-0076]

FACT_ID: sec13-R06 | anchor: A04
Roads are slickest in the first half hour of rain because oil from vehicles has not yet washed off, so slow down, take extra care at intersections, and allow at least twice the normal following distance. [A04]
Why it matters: group rain; difficulty high; prereq none; confusables none [A04]
Source: [A04 -> src:rdmv-mi-s:michigan-department-of-state-secretary-o:handbook:pdf-0076]

FACT_ID: sec13-R07 | anchor: A04
After deep water or heavy rain, test your brakes, which may pull or fail to hold, and press gently while driving slowly until they work normally. [A04]
Why it matters: group rain; difficulty medium; prereq none; confusables none [A04]
Source: [A04 -> src:rdmv-mi-s:michigan-department-of-state-secretary-o:handbook:pdf-0076]

FACT_ID: sec13-R08 | anchor: A04
Hydroplaning happens when tires ride on top of water and can cost you control; worn tires, low pressure and too much speed make it more likely. [A04]
Why it matters: group rain; difficulty medium; prereq none; confusables none [A04]
Source: [A04 -> src:rdmv-mi-s:michigan-department-of-state-secretary-o:handbook:pdf-0076]

FACT_ID: sec13-R09 | anchor: A05
Never drive around barricades closing a flooded road, since debris, power lines or a washed-out road may be hidden; without barricades, consider another route, and deep water can damage the engine. [A05]
Why it matters: group floods; difficulty medium; prereq none; confusables none [A05]
Source: [A05 -> src:rdmv-mi-s:michigan-department-of-state-secretary-o:handbook:pdf-0077]

FACT_ID: sec13-R10 | anchor: A05
Drive slowly in fog with low-beam headlights, ready to stop, and if you cannot see at all, pull off, turn on the four-way flashers and wait. [A05]
Why it matters: group fog; difficulty high; prereq none; confusables none [A05]
Source: [A05 -> src:rdmv-mi-s:michigan-department-of-state-secretary-o:handbook:pdf-0077]

FACT_ID: sec13-R11 | anchor: A05
On ice and snow drive slowly, slow down gradually, and listen and watch for snowmobiles and trail crossing signs, since stopping power is reduced. [A05]
Why it matters: group ice and snow; difficulty medium; prereq none; confusables none [A05]
Source: [A05 -> src:rdmv-mi-s:michigan-department-of-state-secretary-o:handbook:pdf-0077]

FACT_ID: sec13-R12 | anchor: A05
Most skids come from turning too fast or stopping suddenly on slippery pavement, so test the brakes lightly to feel the road. [A05]
Why it matters: group skids; difficulty medium; prereq none; confusables none [A05]
Source: [A05 -> src:rdmv-mi-s:michigan-department-of-state-secretary-o:handbook:pdf-0077]

FACT_ID: sec13-R13 | anchor: A05
With standard brakes, steady pressure without locking the wheels keeps them turning so you can steer, while with full anti-lock brakes you keep pressing and steer. [A05]
Why it matters: group braking; difficulty high; prereq none; confusables sec13-R15 [A05]
Source: [A05 -> src:rdmv-mi-s:michigan-department-of-state-secretary-o:handbook:pdf-0077]

FACT_ID: sec13-R14 | anchor: A05
In a skid, lift off the accelerator, point the front wheels only where you want to go, expect a secondary skid the other way, steer again, then straighten the wheels. [A05]
Why it matters: group skids; difficulty high; prereq none; confusables none [A05]
Source: [A05 -> src:rdmv-mi-s:michigan-department-of-state-secretary-o:handbook:pdf-0077]

FACT_ID: sec13-R15 | anchor: A05
Anti-lock brakes need hard, firm pressure from the start held until you stop, and vibration or pulsing is normal, while without anti-lock you brake just short of locking and release and reapply if the wheels lock, called threshold or controlled braking. [A05]
Why it matters: group braking; difficulty high; prereq none; confusables sec13-R13 [A05]
Source: [A05 -> src:rdmv-mi-s:michigan-department-of-state-secretary-o:handbook:pdf-0077]

FACT_ID: sec13-R16 | anchor: A05
Under normal conditions, a steady, firm push on the brake pedal is how you slow and stop. [A05]
Why it matters: group braking; difficulty low; prereq none; confusables sec13-R15 [A05]
Source: [A05 -> src:rdmv-mi-s:michigan-department-of-state-secretary-o:handbook:pdf-0077]

FACT_ID: sec13-R17 | anchor: A03
On a two-lane freeway you keep right except in listed cases, but with three or more lanes any lane is allowed unless you are near the minimum speed. [A03]
Why it matters: group freeway lanes; difficulty high; prereq none; confusables sec13-F21, sec13-F22 [A03]
Source: [A03 -> src:rdmv-mi-s:michigan-department-of-state-secretary-o:handbook:pdf-0075]

FACT_ID: sec13-R18 | anchor: A03
HOV restrictions apply only during peak hours, and motorcycles are exempt at all times. [A03]
Why it matters: group freeway lanes; difficulty medium; prereq none; confusables sec13-F23 [A03]
Source: [A03 -> src:rdmv-mi-s:michigan-department-of-state-secretary-o:handbook:pdf-0075]

FACT_ID: sec13-R19 | anchor: A03
The merging driver, not freeway traffic, must adjust speed and placement to merge safely. [A03]
Why it matters: group merging; difficulty high; prereq none; confusables sec13-F26 [A03]
Source: [A03 -> src:rdmv-mi-s:michigan-department-of-state-secretary-o:handbook:pdf-0075]

FACT_ID: sec13-R20 | anchor: A04
Tapping the accelerator leaves cruise control on, but touching the brake turns it off. [A04]
Why it matters: group cruise control; difficulty medium; prereq none; confusables sec13-F33 [A04]
Source: [A04 -> src:rdmv-mi-s:michigan-department-of-state-secretary-o:handbook:pdf-0076]
